coverage: Both English editions: named cast, all printed speaker labels, distinct masque roles, named references and selected identifiable unnamed figures. Generic pronouns, imagined crowds and ordinary oaths excluded.

entities.name: Prospero
entities.body: Miranda’s father, a magician living with her on the island.

snapshots.body: Miranda’s father, a magician who was once Duke of Milan.
Miranda’s father, the magician restored to his dukedom in Milan.

entities.name: Miranda
entities.body: Prospero’s daughter, brought up with him on the island.

snapshots.body: Prospero’s daughter, now pledged to marry Ferdinand.

entities.name: Ariel
entities.body: The spirit who serves Prospero and carries out his magic.

entities.name: Caliban
entities.body: Sycorax’s son, an island inhabitant whom Prospero keeps in servitude.

entities.name: Ferdinand
entities.body: The prince of Naples, son of King Alonso.

snapshots.body: Alonso’s son, the prince of Naples, now pledged to marry Miranda.

entities.name: Alonso
entities.body: King of Naples and father of Ferdinand and Claribel.

entities.name: Antonio
entities.body: The Duke of Milan, traveling with King Alonso.

snapshots.body: Prospero’s brother and Miranda’s uncle, now holding the dukedom of Milan.
Prospero’s brother and Miranda’s uncle, the former Duke of Milan.

entities.name: Sebastian
entities.body: King Alonso’s brother.

entities.name: Gonzalo
entities.body: An elderly counselor traveling with King Alonso.

entities.name: Adrian
entities.body: A lord in King Alonso’s traveling party.

entities.name: Francisco
entities.body: A lord in King Alonso’s traveling party.

entities.name: Trinculo
entities.body: King Alonso’s jester.

entities.name: Stephano
entities.body: King Alonso’s butler.

entities.name: The boatswain
entities.body: The ship’s officer directing the sailors during the storm.

entities.name: The ship’s master
entities.body: The captain of the ship carrying King Alonso’s party.

entities.name: The mariners
entities.body: The crew of the ship carrying King Alonso’s party.

entities.name: Sycorax
entities.body: Caliban’s mother, a witch who lived on the island before Prospero.

entities.name: Claribel
entities.body: Alonso’s daughter and Ferdinand’s sister, newly married to the King of Tunis.

entities.name: The King of Tunis
entities.body: Claribel’s husband and ruler of Tunis.

entities.name: Antonio’s son
entities.body: The unnamed son of Antonio, mentioned among the ship’s passengers.

entities.name: Miranda’s mother
entities.body: Prospero’s wife and Miranda’s mother. She is not named in the play.

entities.name: Jove
entities.body: The Roman sky and thunder god, also called Jupiter.

entities.name: Neptune
entities.body: The Roman god of the sea.

entities.name: Setebos
entities.body: The god worshipped by Sycorax and invoked by Caliban.

entities.name: Dido
entities.body: The legendary queen of Carthage, associated with Aeneas in Virgil’s Aeneid.

entities.name: Aeneas
entities.body: The Trojan hero of Virgil’s Aeneid, associated with Dido at Carthage.

entities.name: Hymen
entities.body: The classical god of marriage, whose torch represents the wedding ceremony.

entities.name: Phoebus
entities.body: A name for Apollo as the sun god, imagined driving a chariot across the sky.

entities.name: Venus
entities.body: The Roman goddess of love and mother of Cupid.

entities.name: Cupid
entities.body: The winged god of love, Venus’s son.

entities.name: Dis
entities.body: The Roman ruler of the underworld, also called Pluto.

entities.name: Mars
entities.body: The Roman god of war, associated with Venus as her lover.

entities.name: Iris
entities.body: The rainbow goddess and messenger of Juno, portrayed in Prospero’s masque.

entities.name: Ceres
entities.body: The goddess of agriculture, portrayed in Prospero’s masque.

entities.name: Juno
entities.body: The queen of the gods and goddess of marriage, portrayed in Prospero’s masque.

entities.name: The nymphs
entities.body: The water spirits, or Naiads, represented by dancers in Prospero’s masque.

entities.name: The reapers
entities.body: The harvest workers represented by dancers in Prospero’s masque.

entities.name: The banquet figures
entities.body: The strange figures who bring in and remove the banquet.

entities.name: The spirit hounds
entities.body: The spirits appearing as hunting dogs under Prospero and Ariel’s direction.

entities.name: Mountain
entities.body: One of the spirit hounds called by name during the chase.

entities.name: Silver
entities.body: One of the spirit hounds called by name during the chase.

entities.name: Fury
entities.body: One of the spirit hounds called by name during the chase.

entities.name: Tyrant
entities.body: One of the spirit hounds called by name during the chase.

entities.name: Mall / Moll
entities.body: One of the women named in Stephano’s sailors’ song.

entities.name: Meg
entities.body: One of the women named in Stephano’s sailors’ song.

entities.name: Marian
entities.body: One of the women named in Stephano’s sailors’ song.

entities.name: Margery
entities.body: One of the women named in Stephano’s sailors’ song.

entities.name: Kate
entities.body: One of the women named in Stephano’s sailors’ song.

entities.name: Temperance
entities.body: A woman’s name in Antonio’s joke about the word “temperance”; no further identity is given.

entities.name: Nobody
entities.body: The comic figure of “Nobody,” invoked when Trinculo hears music without seeing a musician.

entities.name: Fortune
entities.body: Good or bad luck imagined as a female power.

entities.name: Fate
entities.body: Destiny imagined as a power governing human lives.
